semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The primary heading for the Executive Summary section, appearing in both the Table of Contents (B000011) and the body text start (B000034). B000011 is a TOC entry summarizing the section; B000034 is the actual section header in the narrative.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Defines the start of the Executive Summary content block. The occurrence at B000011 serves as a navigational pointer in the document structure, while B000034 marks the textual beginning of that section.

semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The heading for Section III, titled 'Financial Results', found in the Table of Contents (B000013). It denotes the start of the detailed financial performance analysis.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Marks the structural division for the Financial Results chapter. It is distinct from SN-001 as it refers to a different section (Section III vs Section I).
